data.name: Jayan
data.gender_notes: Jayan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jayan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jaya' which means 'victorious' or 'conqueror'. The name is used in Hindu mythology for various gods and figures who symbolize success, triumph, and power. The name Jayan carries the meaning “Victorious, Successful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jayan usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, successful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May this name bring you victory in all aspects of life.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jayan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
